subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

After working tirelessly on the project for weeks, Mark finally decided to burn the midnight _________.
solution:
The correct answer is '**oil**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase "**burn the midnight oil**" is an idiom that means working late into the night or studying until late hours.
 
• It originates from the era when oil lamps were used for lighting while working late.
 
• The other options: "**water**," "**food**," and "**paper**" do not fit the context or meaning of the idiom.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *After working tirelessly on the project for weeks, Mark finally decided to burn the midnight oil__.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Water**: Does not fit the idiomatic usage.
 
• **Food**: Does not match the meaning of working late.
 
• **Paper**: Irrelevant to the idiom.
